hero.title: Is Breathe actually right for you?
hero.subtitle: No app is perfect for everyone. Here's an honest look at where Breathe shines, and where it doesn't try to be something it's not.
item-1.title: What works
item-1.list: Completely free, no subscription or trial
Custom inhale / exhale timings, not just presets
item-2.title: What to know
item-2.list: No guided voice narration - visuals and rhythm only
Smaller background library than some paid apps
verdict.body: If you want a calm breathing session without narration, subscriptions, or setup - Breathe is built for exactly that.
tabs.title: Good fit vs. not a fit
tabs.panel-1-list: You want something free that stays free
You like ambient visuals over spoken guidance
You practice offline or while traveling
tabs.panel-2-list: You specifically want narrated meditation sessions
You want sleep or heart-rate tracking built in
You need a huge, constantly-updated content library
cta.title: Decide for yourself - it's free.
cta.subtitle: No account, no trial clock, no risk in trying it.
